title: Formal Verification of 2-Adic Valuation Shifts and p^2 q Jump Dynamics in Generalized Collatz Extensions (Lean 4)
description: Lean 4 formalization of 2-adic valuation shifts and p^2 q jump dynamics in generalized Collatz extensions. Formalizes verified algebraic jump identities in Lean 4 without claiming an unconditional resolution of the global Collatz conjecture. Copyright (c) 2026 Benjamin Stanley Frohman.
